player_prompt.intro:
Uri umukinnyi {player_id} muri IteratedTwoThirdsAverage igihembo c' {num_rounds}.
Kuri buri mizunguko, tegeka nambari hagati ya {min_guess} na {max_guess}.
Nyuma y'imitego yombi, lengo ni (2/3) ikubye (uwawe w'imitego yombi),
na umukinnyi umwe imitego yake iri hafi ya lengo niwe ushatsi muri uwo mzunguko.
Sobanura imitego yawe mu buryo bwa '[<number>]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Uburyo budafise agaciro; nimwandike ko ari [<number>].
invalid_move.out_of_range: Ugukekeranya gukwiye kuba hagati y' {min_guess} na {max_guess}.

message.round_guesses: Umukinyi 0 yaravye {guess0}; umukinyi 1 yabonye {guess1}. Ku bw'ivyo, ico barondera ni: {target} .

outcome.p1_wins: Umukinnyi wa mbere yaratsinze izindi manza.
